Sara —

Appreciate the quick reply and the draft. A few quick responses inline below and attaching the Order Form template to capture party/billing and pilot sizing.

On SOC 2: yes — Redwood accepts a current SOC 2 Type II report for access and audit purposes. We can provide the latest report under NDA; let me know if you need the external AICPA PDF or a summarized controls matrix.

On data deletion: our standard language is 90 days for backups and 30 days for active residuals. We can support a 30-day deletion obligation for pilot data; I'll flag with legal if you intend to make that a standing contract term.

Suggested quick wins to speed contracting:
- Start with a 3-month pilot Order Form with limited monthly token caps — this avoids full production SLA negotiations initially.
- On indemnity/IP: our standard is mutual indemnity limited to direct damages and a customary carve-out for third-party IP claims. If Acadia has specific IP exclusions, please highlight them and we can route to our counsel.

Attachments: OrderForm_Acadia.xlsx (Order Form template)

If you're good with the pilot approach, I'd propose: legal redlines by 12/5, commercial term sheet by 12/6, pilot start in the week of 12/15. Happy to jump on a 30-min call Tuesday to walk through key clauses.

Best,
